configuration.adaptive_rule: FP16 classical IR (4 iterations), then FP32 classical IR (12), then FP64 Cholesky. Each stage solves from original A/B and is gated only by status, device info and max per-RHS original-system relative L2 residual <=1e-12. No forward-error oracle is used online.
configuration.precision_scope: FP64 inputs/output; requested lowest precision and library iteration/fallback codes are retained. Requested flags do not prove Tensor Core execution of every internal operation.
configuration.boundaries: Resident: fresh restore/equilibration/factorization/solve and full original-system GPU residual with host decision. CUDA event intervals include IRS host gaps; host wall recorded separately. Host request: pageable FP64 A+B H2D, complete solve/gate, full FP64 X D2H; RHS cycles through four variants. Reuse mode excludes a separately measured FP64 factor setup and uploads only changing B. Plan allocation, library initialization, CPU input generation, witnesses and history extraction are outside solve timings.
configuration.memory_scope: Explicit owned CUDA buffers/workspaces only. cuSOLVER/cuBLAS handles and opaque internal allocations are additional; these are not whole-device peak measurements.
